hazards.evidence: Full-height tub wall must be stepped over; the shower chair sits entirely inside the tub and there is no transfer bench bridging the rim, so a walker user after hip/knee replacement must lift a leg over the rim.
Toilet has a standard/low seat (no raised seat) even though a metal safety frame is present; seat height appears too low for post-hip/knee precautions.
Smooth acrylic tub floor with only partial adhesive tread strips; remaining surface is slick when wet during the stand-to-sit transfer.
Black power cord from the radio on the window sill drapes down the wall right beside the toilet/safety frame where the user stands and positions a walker.
